summary: Executed backend API regression and targeted frontend integration checks for new About-page Team content on the public preview URL. Team cards, bilingual rendering (EN/HI), email link behavior, founder content continuity, navigation, and contact form submission all passed.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials; auth testing was not in scope for this run.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST records via POST /api/inquiries and POST /api/status during backend regression; submitted one UI contact inquiry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated against https://info-showcase-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed About page includes Team section with 10 member cards, EN/HI language toggle updates team copy correctly, email anchors use mailto links in both languages and mobile, founder page content still renders, nav routes /about,/founder,/products,/impact,/contact work, and contact form success toast appears.
rca of the issue: No functional regressions found in this iteration. One initial false negative occurred due to an over-broad test selector matching a non-anchor team email block; corrected selector to anchor-specific data-testid and revalidated successfully.
